# AI Agents for Sales Operations — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Rank your workflows

*Module 1: Agent-suitable sales workflows · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_rank_workflows.py`): Score your own six workflows. The top one becomes your prototype in the next lab; the bottom one goes on the 'do not automate' list with a reason.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Lead-qualification agent prototype

*Module 2: Building with no-code / CRM AI · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_lead_qualification_agent.py`): Rebuild this flow in your CRM's AI / automation platform. List every tool you gave it and mark each read or write. Which writes need approval?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Metrics sheet

*Module 3: Measuring and governing · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_metrics_and_governance.py`): Define the four numbers you would report every Monday and the threshold at which you would switch the agent back to read-only.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
